resale_co.notes: The official website (https://www.newfieldborough.org/) answered every request, including direct PDF links, with a SiteGround bot-check (captcha) page, so no page or form could be read. The town code on ecode360 cannot be opened. Web searches did not return any official page or form text about a resale certificate for this town. Status is unknown, not confirmed absent. A search-engine summary pointed to the Borough Hall at 18 Catawba Avenue and a main number of 856-697-1100, but that could not be confirmed on an official page, so it is not used.

authorities.name: Gloucester County Fire Marshal's Office (county local enforcing agency for the Uniform Fire Code)
authorities.how_to_apply: No County smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate form or fee for home sales was found on the County website. Call or email the County Fire Marshal's Office (212 County House Road, Clarksboro) and ask how to request the resale inspection for this town, and whether the town collects the application and fee.

evidence.quote: The County Fire Marshal's Office currently is the Local Enforcement Agency (LEA) for the following municipalities: Clayton East Greenwich Elk National Park Newfield Paulsboro South Harrison Wenonah West Deptford Woodbury Woodbury Heights

fire_cert.notes: The DCA Division of Fire Safety LEA Registry (third quarter, July 2026, as of June 30, 2026) lists this town with code C (C = County), and the Gloucester County Office of the Fire Marshal page lists Newfield among the municipalities where the County Fire Marshal's Office is the local enforcing agency. The authority type list has no 'county' option, so type is set to 'unknown'. The town has no fire district (it is not on the DCA Division of Local Government Services list of Gloucester County fire districts: https://nj.gov/dca/divisions/dlgs/programs/lpcl_docs/cd_gloucester.docx). In other county-LEA towns (for example Clayton) the municipality itself posts the smoke/CO application and collects the fee, so the town office may be the place to apply; this could not be checked here because the town website is blocked. Under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3, if the town has its own resale inspection under a municipal code, a separate CSACMAPFEC is not required but the town cannot issue its approval until smoke/CO/extinguisher rules (N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19) are met.
